title: Archive playbook for admin events with append-only bundles and verification
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Produce an operational playbook and implementation for capturing admin-related audit events (admin actions, privileged access, config changes), storing them as append-only archival bundles with verifiable integrity and configurable residency/retention. This ticket covers design, storage choices, signing and timestamping strategy, API surface for export and legal hold, migration of recent events into the new archive format, and observability for evidence availability and verification failures.
acceptance_criteria: All admin event types (user admin actions, role changes, SSO config updates, access grants/revokes, critical config edits) are ingested into an append-only bundling pipeline within max 60s of occurrence.
Each archival bundle is stored in an immutable object with a cryptographic manifest: bundle SHA-256, bundle sequence number, signing key fingerprint, and RFC3339 timestamp.
Bundles can be exported per-tenant with residency constraints (region-tagged storage) and retention policy enforcement (expire, legal hold, manual retention extension).
Verification tooling (CLI + HTTP verify endpoint) can validate a bundle chain against KMS/HSM-signed root stamps and surface mismatches in the Console and an alerts channel.
Migration path exists to repackage last 90 days of admin events into append-only bundles without blocking ingestion or causing >2s tail latency on API requests.
Documentation and runbook published (Confluence) plus an incident playbook for verification failures and contested evidence requests.
Automated tests cover bundle creation, immutability enforcement, export, and verification checks in CI with mocked KMS.
Data residency tags are applied and enforced for all stored bundles; policy violations raise high-priority alerts.
Feature flag gating for rollout and gradual enablement for Dedicated/Private customers.
Security review signoff recorded and required changes addressed.
SLOs defined: bundle production latency <60s 99th, verification success rate >=99.9% over 24h.
tasks: Design: document bundle format, manifest schema, and signing/timestamp protocol (SHA-256 hash chain + KMS/HSM signing)
Storage: implement append-only object layout using object-lock / immutability features and metadata for region/residency tags
Ingestion: wire audit stream (Kafka topic) to bundler service with batching heuristics and flush triggers
Signing: integrate with KMS for envelope signing; implement local HSM path for Private installs
API: build export endpoint /audit-bundles/export and verify endpoint /audit-bundles/verify
Console: add bundle viewer, verification status, and retention controls in admin UI
Migration: write migration tool to assemble recent events into bundles and validate chain
Testing: end-to-end tests with mocked KMS and residence simulation; load test bundler under realistic admin event rates
Docs & runbook: Confluence pages + on-call steps for verification alerts
Rollout: feature-flagged canary rollout, telemetry dashboards, and alerting thresholds
design_decisions: Use SHA-256 for content hashing and create a serial bundle chain where each bundle header includes previous bundle hash to make tamper-evident chains.
Sign bundle manifests with project KMS; for Private deployments allow customer HSM-provided signing keys and offline stamping workflow.
Store bundles in cloud object storage with Object Lock/immutability primitives when available; fallback to signed ledger and cold vault when immutability unavailable.
Retention is enforced by metadata-driven lifecycle jobs; legal hold overrides lifecycle and requires operator approval recorded in audit.
Design API to return pre-signed export packages (tar.gz + manifest + signatures) with paginated listing for large ranges.
Verification will attempt key rotation lookups: store signer key fingerprint and signature method in manifest to allow future key rotation verification.
Keep bundle size between 5MB and 200MB to balance verification cost and retrieval latency; support time- or size-based flushing triggers.
Avoid per-event individual signing due to cost; instead sign per-bundle and rely on internal signed ingestion offsets for intra-bundle ordering proofs.
migration_plan: Phase 1: create read-only snapshot exporter for last 90 days of admin events; run in dry mode to produce candidate bundles.
Phase 2: validate candidate bundles with verification tooling and surface mismatches.
Phase 3: run migration in background, streaming new events into live bundler while backfilling historical bundles; ensure dedup idempotency using event UUIDs.
Phase 4: once backfill completes and verification passes, switch archive queries to new archive index and deprecate legacy event store exports.
Fallback: if verification fails at scale, pause backfill and open rollback plan to legacy exports + notify legal/compliance stakeholders.
monitoring: Metric: bundle_produced.count partitioned by region, tenant, and result (success/failure)
Metric: verification_failures.count with error tags (signature, hash-mismatch, missing-key)
Alert: verification_failures.rate > 0.1% over 1h -> P0 page to engineering oncall
Alert: bundle_production_latency.P99 > 60s -> Investigate batching pressure or storage slowdowns
Dashboard: per-tenant retention compliance heatmap and residency violations table
